name: rental_daily_cron
why: Crystal's case: a daily rental job against a metered API (RentCast, hard cap 50/month). The real rentals catalog is published — its own descriptions beg for ONE listings_search with neighborhoods comma-joined, and listings_get burns a request per listing. The gate is spend discipline: exactly one search, no detail or market calls the human did not ask for, and the two listings with who to call in the reply — not “found some options.”
cron: Daily rental check for the housing aim: new 2BR listings in Ballard or Fremont under $2400. Report anything new with who to call.
